blurb: Pipers Lagoon Park is an 8 hectare waterfront park built on an isthmus extending to a rocky headland. It features twisting trails leading to seaside lookouts with views of Shack Island and Neck Point Park. The park is ideal for bird watching, beachcombing, and swimming in summer.
